items.item: PF-020/PF-021 a candidate adds, modifies, deletes and renames files in a scratch copy, is bound to base, contract, oracle and provenance, and never touches the working tree
tests: PF-020/021 a feature candidate adds files, modifies one and is bound to base, contract, oracle and provenance — without touching the working tree
renames and deletes appear in the inventory as such, with attribution that says what is and is not covered

items.item: Identical edits replay to the same binding; different edits supersede the earlier candidate
tests: the same edits produce the same binding (replay, no new ordinal); different edits supersede the earlier candidate

items.item: PF-055 admission: traversal, absolute paths, secrets, VCS, protected files, stale hashes, overlap and caps are refused with reasons
tests: PF-055 admission: traversal, absolute paths, secrets, VCS, lockfiles, bad bytes, stale hashes, overlap and caps are all refused with reasons

items.item: PF-055/AT-13 existing tests are protected: adding is free, editing needs a policy grant, a granted weakening is recorded as pending review
tests: PF-055/AT-13 existing tests: adding is free; editing or deleting needs a policy grant, and a granted weakening is recorded as pending review

items.item: Dependency and install-script changes need a security grant; grants need authority
tests: dependencies: package.json dependency and install-script changes need a security grant; other package.json edits do not

items.item: PF-021/AT-22 a stale base is refused up front and a candidate goes stale when the repository changes
tests: PF-021/AT-22 a stale base is refused up front, and a candidate goes stale the moment the repository changes

items.item: Build gates: PLAN mode, missing contract, open questions, mandatory tracking, wrong owner and state refuse to build
tests: gates: PLAN mode, missing contract, open questions, mandatory tracking, wrong owner and wrong state all refuse to build

items.item: PF-072 readCandidateFile: candidate, baseline, unified and split diff, ranges, truncation, deleted files, traversal and access
tests: PF-072 reading a candidate: every representation, ranges, truncation, deleted files, traversal and access

items.item: Honest reporting of no-op candidates and edits that end up unchanged
tests: a candidate that changes nothing, or whose edit leaves a file unchanged, is reported honestly

items.item: planFeatureChange / planReuseChange consume task 2.I's impact assessment
